name: Setenaya
role: Mother and matriarch of the Narts
fun_fact: In Ossetian tradition she is born from the dead Dzerassae, while Circassian tellers say she was born from a flower, the dropwort that still bears her name.

name: Sosruko
fun_fact: He is small and dark rather than tall and fair, and the sagas treat his cunning, not his strength, as the real source of his fame.

name: Batraz
role: Steel-bodied storm hero of the Narts
fun_fact: He chooses his own death, dancing on his funeral pyre until white-hot before his sword is thrown into the sea.

name: Syrdon
role: Trickster and slanderer of the Narts
fun_fact: He is credited with inventing the fandyr, the Nart harp, and with knowing everything before it happened.

name: Nasran
role: Long-bearded elder and counsellor of the Narts
fun_fact: In the Circassian fire tale it is Nasran Longbeard who admits that the Narts should never have ridden out without Sosruko.

name: Khamyts
role: Nart warrior and father of Batraz
fun_fact: His steel moustache turns aside the snakes and lizards that rise from the Uatsamonga cup.

name: Uryzmag
role: Elder of the Narts and husband of Setenaya
fun_fact: He is one of the few Nart heroes shown growing old, and the sagas keep his marriage to Setenaya at the centre of the household.

name: Aishana
role: Young Nart hero raised in the sky
fun_fact: Born to Uryzmag's household, he is raised by Safa in the sky and wins fame by defeating the Agur raiders.

name: Tlepsh
fun_fact: His Ossetian counterpart is the smith Kurdalagon, and Circassian tales credit him with forging the Narts' weapons and tempering their heroes.

name: Waig
role: One-eyed giant of the Ossetian sagas
fun_fact: Waigs are huge and strong but foolish, and their towers and fires are the setting for some of the Narts' boldest tricks.
